# Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline

Camera/gallery video pick, thumbnail, OS transcode when over budget, and encrypt. No FFmpeg.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-video-pipeline/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios, net10.0-maccatalyst, net10.0-windows10.0.17763.0

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, Windows (shared library).

## Current release

1.1.0. Probe duration / size / resolution, JPEG thumbnail, OS transcode when over budget. No FFmpeg. `CannotTranscode` if the device cannot encode. `UseVideoPipeline` `DefaultMaxDuration` applies when the builder omits `MaxDuration`. Host apps must declare Android and iOS permissions listed in the README.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline

Registration: `UseVideoPipeline` — see README.md. Use `FromCamera()` / `FromGallery()` / `FromFile`. There is no singleton `Current`.

```csharp
var result = await VideoPipeline.FromGallery()
    .MaxDuration(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30))
    .MaxBytes(12 * 1024 * 1024)
    .Encrypt(key)
    .SaveAsync();
```

Over budget tries an OS transcode, then `TooLarge` / `TooLong` / `CannotTranscode`. Tests inject `UseProcessor`.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I pick a video, cap size, thumbnail it, transcode it, and encrypt it in MAUI?
- Camera/gallery video before upload

## Do not use when

- Image pipeline (use Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline)
- Guaranteed FFmpeg compress on every Android device
- Barcode / QR scanning
